name: b12 Labs
long_description:
b12 makes high-value molecules that are otherwise hard to make. We help pharma companies plan and make new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months.

Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (1000+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference.
Zlatko is a 3x National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level, and medicinal chemist who has worked at Roche and leading lab robotics companies. 

Combined, we have an extensive network of hundreds of chemists, automation scientists, and AI 4 Science researchers.

We run paid pilots with big pharma companies, demonstrating that our platform planned a set of experiments that achieved full conversion in a single attempt, eliminating the iteration cycle.
one_liner: Making hard molecules for Pharma and Biotech

founders.founder_bio:
at b-12 we are developing AI agents for automated workflows in chemistry and pharma R&D, as a way of manifestating chemical super intelligence in physical world.

our long-term goal is to create autonomous labs that can perform complex, multistep syntheses with minimal human intervention.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Before b-12, Andres built the first AI agent to plan and make molecules in a robotic lab (750+ cites in Nature Machine Intelligence,  and Best Paper at NeurIPS AI for Science), along with several other works in agents and LLMs for chemistry (1100+ citations).
He was an Intern at Max Planck (Math in Science), and PhD at EPFL (AI+Chemistry).

Automation is the future of chemistry, but integration and human operability is the hidden demon nobody talks about. We're fixing that at b-12.

launches.title: b-12 - Chemistry Copilot for Pharma & Biotech
launches.tagline: Full Stack Chemistry Platform - from planning to robotic execution of experiments
launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

Drug discovery is slow, and it costs billions of dollars. The bottleneck in early discovery is chemical synthesis. b-12 is building a full stack of AI agents to deliver planning and robotic executions of experiments, in minutes, not months. **Our team has developed custom robots for chemistry (Chemspeed), orchestrated AI agents for lab control (EPFL & IBM), and is translating this into a powerful and easy-to-use product.**

**Ask:** Are you running chemistry experiments or chemical robots? Do you know someone who is? Email us at [founders@b12-labs.com](mailto:founders@b12-labs.com) to be added to our pilot program. See below for details.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qmf7q-Sie2o

# ❌ **The problem:**

**Drug Discovery is slow:**

* It takes 10+ years and over $2 billion to discover a new drug.
* 2 in 10000 compounds make it.
* Chemistry execution is very slow.

Experiments take time! Designing good experiments and trial and error in the lab are big factors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/0cd3f202-e48b-48da-a6e5-3ae1572cddab)

**Software for chemists is fragmented:**

* There are many solutions for many different parts of the pipeline.
* Tools are outdated, and integration is largely missing.

**Lab robots are underused:**

* Most lab robots are _not accessible to scientists_ because they are hard to use.
* Drag and drop software for multimillion-dollar robotic labs.
* Lab automation engineers are hard to find.

**Current State:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/2a3d91a0-8e78-44d9-a89c-f1dcc7b45f67)

**b-12:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/893d0cd2-d071-43be-b08e-ddf29b8aaddc)

# ✅ **Our** **Solution:**

We are integrating a full stack of Agents to **design experiments** and **write code for the robot** that runs these experiments, with the tools and context needed to predict chemically meaningful results, and close the experimental loop.\
\
**Key capabilities of our Agents:**

* **Streamline Experiment Planning**: Our tools accelerate creation of experimental details based on literature and expert tools, and tailor the output to the user’s specific needs.
* **Unified platform:** Our platform integrates several agents that are in tight communication and can go from natural language input to robotic execution in minutes.
* **No coding required - use natural language:** With arbitrary input flexibility, we can control the robot the same way you would talk to your lab-mates, including inputs from previous runs, and uploading relevant documents.
* **Parallel and scalable to any lab:** We are vendor agnostic, and integrate with different robotics (Chemspeed, Unchained, Opentrons, etc.) and labs performing experiments manually.

**Pilot Program:** Our team will work on integrating Agentic solutions tailored to your lab's specific problems, whether you use lab automation or not. We want to speed up molecular discovery.

# **👥 Our Team:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92473&key=user_uploads/2507050/92133d6c-ba4b-4722-9115-8c45405366aa)

We are Zlatko and Andres, and in the past, we have:

1. Worked with big pharma (Roche), Chemical Robotics ([**Chemspeed**](https://chemspeed.com/)), and big chemical data ([**MaxPlanck**](https://www.mis.mpg.de/));
2. Pioneered [**AI agents**](https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-024-00832-8) for chemistry and [**retrosynthesis**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.08537) (at EPFL);
3. Invented [**new chemistry**](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/anie.202211168);

Now we want to integrate it into a seamless platform, where anyone who wants to run experiments gets extra **brainpower** and an **additional pair of hands**.

We would love a warm intro!
